live_batch.component: bridge.autoplay driven directly (--allow-actions --out-of-combat-only), not through scripts/supervise_solver_batch.py
live_batch.why_direct_not_supervised: Steam auto-updated CombatSolver when the client started (lock AEF11717 -> disk B66D7C05); the supervised comparison child gates on that hash and the solver lock is operator-owned, so it was left unreconciled rather than re-pinned here
live_batch.starting_state: resumed a pre-existing suspended standard/A10 run at act 2 floor 19 (operator-approved), which the identity guard first refused for a fixable reason -- see autoplay_identity_fix
live_batch.autoplay_identity_fix: the guard read an identity-less transition frame as 'not Ironclad'; absence is now waited on under a 60s deadline instead of refusing a legitimate resume

verdict.reading_before_this_change: None / game_over_message_wording, because the message is the hard-coded literal 'Run ended.' for both outcomes
verdict.victory_branch: NOT EXERCISED -- reaching it requires actually clearing the final act's second boss; no run in this project has done that on the real client

side_effects_to_know_about.fresh_run_started_by_the_driver: after the death, the menu branch began a new Ironclad A10 run (act 1 floor 1) before max-runs stopped the loop; no run was abandoned and no save was deleted
